name: Hookline Transit Sling Pack — Depot Edition
description: Single-strap courier bag in matte slate-gray recycled synthcanvas, reinforced at the base panel with a strip of reflective orange safety trim. The main body is boxy and unadorned except for a Hookline Independent stencil-stamp on the flap — faded from wash cycles. Interior smells faintly of machine oil and transit tokens. Widely used by Circuit-tier workers who can't afford anything with a proper corporate badge but need something that holds up across a twelve-hour shift.
functionality: Main compartment fits a 15-inch slate, secondary zip pocket for documents, exterior lash points for overflow gear, padded strap with quick-release. Water-resistant coating rated for moderate acid-rain exposure.
what_it_says: Functional over everything — this person is somewhere to be and doesn't care what you think about their bag.
story_hooks: The bag's interior lining has a hidden false bottom, factory-standard on early runs — Hookline never announced it publicly.
Three of these bags were found abandoned on the same MagRail platform on the same morning; all contained identical unsigned manifests.
A Circuit foreman swears the reflective trim on his bag caught a sniper's laser sight before it found him.
